identification: Two-volume Cyclopedia of Tasmania (half leather, blue cloth boards, gilt fleurons) plus a one-volume red cloth Cyclopedia of Tasmania (probably 1931). MAJOR RISK: the 1988 Prestige Bookbinders limited facsimile of the 1900 set (500 numbered sets) is described by Astrolabe as blue half-leather and cloth with gilt decoration in imitation of the original, which matches these boards. Gowans has sold facsimile pairs at $110 hammer. Worn, flaking spines point to an original but title pages are not shown, so original vs facsimile is unconfirmed.

viewing_check: Open vol I and check title page and imprint: 'Maitland & Krone, Hobart, 1900' (original) versus Prestige Bookbinders 1988 facsimile (look for a limitation number leaf, 'facsimile' statement, modern paper, crisp binding). Check the red volume's title page for 1931 and that plates are present. Check internals for foxing, loose plates, detached boards.
